titulo: Folha de modelagem NPC: ilsa (variacao a)
prompt: MODEL SHEET for 3D modeling (character turnaround) of a NON-PLAYABLE TOWN NPC for the action-RPG "Echoes of the Shatter". Do NOT copy the Mage or the Warrior: this is a different, new character. Attached images 3 and 4 are texture contact sheets of the style reference game: finish quality only. The NPC must look like a finished in-game 3D model of a polished stylized game: sculpted, rounded, chunky bevelled volumes with smooth silhouettes, hand-painted textures with visible brush strokes and soft baked light and violet-tinted shadows. It must NOT look like blocky primitives, cubes, a graybox or a mobile toy. THIS NPC: Ilsa, the Cartographer: a practical, ironic adult woman who maps what changed in the world. Visual: a tall-for-the-cast, slim silhouette with a wide-brimmed round hat (brim wider than the shoulders), a knee-length turquoise travel coat with a high collar and cream scarf, a leather bandolier with ink pots and a brass compass on the chest, and a rolled map tube strapped diagonally on her back that sticks out above one shoulder (visible from front and back). Half-lidded, slightly wry expression. Dark brown trousers and boots. It is a civilian town resident, NOT a hero: no armor, no helmet, no weapon, no class emblem, no heroic cape. Orthographic look, camera at mid-body height, no perspective distortion; all three views at the same scale, aligned on the same ground line, whole body inside each column with a clear margin, feet visible. Neutral A-pose for rigging: standing straight, arms angled about 40 degrees away from the body, palms down, legs slightly apart, friendly neutral face. Hands empty and open. Plain flat uniform light grey background (#C8C8C8), no floor, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid, no frame, no UI. Even neutral lighting so the colors read as albedo, with only soft painted shading.
